section.title: Appearance
section.description: How Plinthio looks for you. Changes show in the preview and save straight away, for your account only.
section.locked: Your admin sets how Plinthio looks on this server, so these can't be changed here. The preview shows what everyone sees.

language.desc: The language Plinthio speaks to you. Automatic follows your browser.

accent.title: Accent colour
accent.desc: Your highlight colour on buttons, badges and the current tab.

pageWidth.title: Page width
pageWidth.desc: How wide pages get on a big screen. Full width fits more posters in a row.

pauseScreen.title: Pause screen
pauseScreen.desc: What appears after a couple of seconds paused on a movie or episode.

full.label: Full Width
full.desc: Use the whole screen, fitting more posters

simple.label: Simple
simple.desc: Just the player controls — nothing covers the picture.

details.label: Details
details.desc: Poster, title, tagline, synopsis, director and cast, and when it will end.

cinematic.label: Cinematic
cinematic.desc: The picture dims behind a full-screen title card with cast photos and facts from TMDB — box office, original title, keywords.

bedtime.label: Bedtime
bedtime.desc: A dim clock with the time it ends and, for shows, when the rest of the season would. Easy on the eyes in a dark room.
